QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Research Subject
QuestInfo.0:
Alika was terrified of the tentacles and quickly crushed them with the nearest rock she could find. Interestingly, the moment she did that, all of the other monsters in the clearing stopped attacking. Was that thing controlling them somehow? 
Alika's decided to take the Jellyrash to the Afinas Base for investigation.
